 myflexbox ist das größte offene Smart Locker Netzwerk in Deutschland und Österreich. Als junges, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen gestalten wir die letzte Meile der Paketlogistik neu — nachhaltig, effizient und kundenfreundlich. Unsere Mission: Wir verbinden Menschen, Pakete und Unternehmen smarter als je zuvor. 

 Das könnte dein Anteil an der Mission sein: 

 Identifizierung und Akquise von Standortpartnern im öffentlichen Bereich (z.B. Städte, Kommunen, Gemeinden)  

 Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Key Accounts im öffentlichen Bereich  

 Verhandlung und Abschluss von Rahmen- und Standortverträgen  

 Koordination und Überwachung der Implementierung neuer Standorte  

 Teilnahme an regionalen Branchenveranstaltungen, Messen und Konferenzen  

 Was wir uns von Dir wünschen: 

 Abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine ähnliche Qualifikation  

 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit und Projektumsetzung mit öffentlichen Partnern, insbesondere mit Städten, Kommunen und Gemeinden 

 Spaß an der Akquise von Neukunden 

 Hands-on-Mentalität  

 Wohnort bevorzugt in einer großen Stadt 

 Offenheit in einem digitalisierten Umfeld mit agilen Arbeitsmethoden zu arbeiten  

 Kundenorientierte, kooperative Arbeitsweise und Überzeugungskraft in Verhandlungen  

 Hohe Bereitschaft zur Reisetätigkeit 

 Was Dich bei uns erwartet: 

 Gestalte Deine Arbeitszeit flexibel und ortsunabhängig – (bis zu) 100% remote. Dank großzügiger Gleitzeit zwischen 6-22 Uhr passt sich Dein Job deinem Alltag an. 

 Arbeite autonom und selbstbestimmt. Wir leben größtmögliche Transparenz, Vertrauen und Offenheit. 

 Immer mobil und schnell dort, wo du gebraucht wirst mit dem Firmen-PKW. 

 Entdecke neue Orte und verbinde Arbeit und Urlaub. Workation ist bei uns bis zu 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland möglich. 

 Sorge vor für’s Alter mit unserem Angebot zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. 

 Arbeite an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft: Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine digitale Infrastruktur, die Menschen entlastet und Ressourcen schont. 

 Erlebe flache Hierarchie mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen in einem dynamischen und hoch motivierten Team mit einzigartigem Spirit. Das „Du“ ist dabei selbstverständlich.

title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) - AI Agent Platform
description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

 Worum es geht 

 Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

 Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

 Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

 Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

 Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sales und unser CRO. Dein Part ist das Gespräch, und was du dort hörst, fließt direkt in die nächste Runde ein.

 Aufgaben Telefon ist dein Hauptkanal. Cold Calling ist der Kern der Rolle, nicht ein Kanal unter mehreren. E-Mail und LinkedIn ergänzen die Ansprache

 Ziellisten aus den Verticals abarbeiten, die Head of Sales und CRO festlegen. Die Listen kommen aufgebaut aus Clay und Cognism. Du priorisierst innerhalb der Liste und bereitest jeden Account kurz vor, bevor du anrufst

title: (Senior) Talent Agent (all genders)
description:
Representing Artists ist eine Künstleragentur für Kreativschaffende aus Film, Fernsehen und Theater. Wir verbinden persönliche, strategische Repräsentation mit einer innovativen digitalen Infrastruktur, die Raum für das Wesentliche schafft: kreative Arbeit.

 Im Mittelpunkt unserer täglichen Agenturarbeit stehen gute Beziehungen, klare Positionierung unserer Klient*innen und ihre erfolgreiche Vermittlung.

 Für unseren nächsten Entwicklungsschritt suchen wir eine erfahrene Agenturpersönlichkeit im Bereich Schauspiel oder Regie & Drehbuch. Du arbeitest seit mehreren Jahren in einer etablierten Künstler*innenagentur, betreust Künstler*innen eigenverantwortlich und möchtest deine Erfahrung in ein Umfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, echter Mitsprache und einer langfristigen Perspektive einbringen.

 Was du bei uns machst Du übernimmst die federführende Betreuung bestimmter Klient*innen und gestaltest ihre künsterlische Positionierung und Entwicklung. Dabei arbeiten wir bewusst nicht in getrennten Portfolios: Unsere Klient*innen werden gemeinsam im Team vertreten und profitieren von unserer gesamten Expertise, unseren Kontakten und unseren unterschiedlichen Perspektiven. Klare Zuständigkeiten und gegenseitige Unterstützung gehören für uns zusammen.

 Klient*innen strategisch beraten, positionieren und langfristig begleiten

 Chancen und Projekte früh erkennen und passende Talente gezielt ins Gespräch bringen

 Beziehungen zu Casting, Produktion, Sendern etc. eigenständig pflegen und ausbauen

 Gagen sowie Bedingungen aushandeln, Verträge prüfen und zum Abschluss bringen

 Profile, Materialien und überzeugende Ansätze für die Ansprache weiterentwickeln

 Gemeinsam mit dem Team attraktive Projektvorschläge und spartenübergreifende Angebote entwickeln und die passenden Branchenpartner überzeugen

 Kontakte, Projektchancen und nächste Schritte im CRM verlässlich steuern und dokumentieren

 Künstlerische Arbeiten unserer Klient*innen begleiten und bei Vorstellungen, Premieren und relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen persönlich präsent sein

 Im Schwerpunkt Schauspiel begleitest du Besetzungsprozesse und entwickelst Positionierung, Materialien und Sichtbarkeit weiter. Im Schwerpunkt Regie & Drehbuch vermittelst du Auftragsarbeiten, platzierst Stoffideen und entwickelst Beziehungen zu passenden Produktions- und Redaktionspartner*innen.

title: Product Manager, Marketplace
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

title: Senior RAMS Engineer
description:
We are looking for a RAMS Engineer to strengthen our safety and compliance team, with a particular emphasis on safety engineering for our vehicles, propulsion systems, ground infrastructure, and operations.

 RAMS covers Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety. This role will apply those principles across the full lifecycle of complex hardware and operational systems, helping ensure that hazards are identified early, risks are controlled, and safety requirements are supported by clear technical evidence.

 Although the role sits within safety and compliance rather than systems engineering, you will need a strong systems-engineering background and experience working with high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

 About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

 We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

 We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

 To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

 At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

 Key responsibilities Establish and develop RAMS and safety-engineering processes across vehicles, propulsion systems, ground systems, facilities, and operations.

 Define, manage, and verify reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety requirements throughout the system lifecycle.

 Lead hazard identification, risk assessments, failure-mode analysis, fault-tree analysis, and other structured safety assessments.

 Develop and maintain safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS plans, safety assessments, compliance evidence, and technical justifications.

 Work with systems, propulsion, avionics, test, manufacturing, operations, and suppliers to identify hazards and implement effective risk controls.

title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)

ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. You are the nerve center of ALPAMI's day-to-day: the person who sees every property, every process, and every issue before it becomes a problem — and who fixes it before the guest even notices.

We're a fast-growing, founder-led company, and we need someone who understands what that actually means in practice: unpredictable days, fast decisions, and a genuine sense of ownership over the outcome. title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

 We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

 With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

 Research questions you could initially work on Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control?

 Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected?

 Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics?

 Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site?

 These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next.

 Your main responsibilities As a Research Scientist, you’ll:

 Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems.

 Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems.

 Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works.

 Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms.

 Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production.

title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
description:
About us 

 We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

 If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

 We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK.

 The role 

 You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why.

 This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it.

 What you'll do 

 Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants.

 Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis.

 Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve.

 Express, purify, and characterise proteins, measuring kinetics, substrate scope, selectivity, and stability under relevant reaction conditions.

 Work with computational scientists to test proposed designs, interpret successes and failures, and use the results to guide the next round.

 Develop enzymatic reactions and cascades, identifying how enzyme performance, cofactors, and reaction conditions affect overall productivity.

 Essential experience 

 We're interested in the engineering campaigns you've run, the assays you've built, and what you learned from them. We care about:

 A track record

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

 THE TEAM 

 Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

 We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

 European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

 THE ROLE 

 You will build our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

 Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO 

 - Design and ship the control plane. You own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle.

 - Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am.

 - Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets.

The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production.

 What You Will Do 

 Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses.

 Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss.

title: Senior ML Engineer (Technical Lead)
description:
Looking for a role where you can use your ML skills to redefine how an entire industry solves core problems? We have that!
Zerolook ($1.9M raised in August 2026, founded by former Google Flights and Kayak execs) is changing how air travel is priced, and ML is at the core of our approach. As an early hire, you get to define the technical approach at the center of it all.

 Tasks Model Architecture: Design and implement high-performance, low-latency ML models for fare and itinerary estimation.

 Data Engineering: Build and maintain robust data pipelines to process massive volumes of historical fare and schedule data.

 Intelligent Routing: Develop confidence scoring systems to intelligently route traffic between ML models and current legacy stacks.

 Domain leadership: develop core domain expertise in the field of using ML for fare and itinerary prediction.

 Technical Leadership: hire, lead and mentor other engineers as the team grows.

 Strategic Collaboration: Partner alongside the founders with key organizations in the industry in developing the core Zerolook offering.

 Requirements Education: Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science or related field.

 Broad ML Knowledge: familiarity with the breadth of ML approaches and their relative strengths and weaknesses.

 Production ML Expertise: 4+ years in designing, training, and deploying ML models in production environments.

 Engineering Foundation: Strong software engineering skills with experience building robust, automated data pipelines.

 Startup DNA: Comfortable with the "0 to 1" phase-ambiguity, fast iteration, and taking extreme ownership.

 Bonus Requirements 

 Travel Tech: Previous experience with OTAs, metasearch, or GDS/NDC integration is a significant plus.

 Large scale applications: experience building applications serving over 10K QPS at latencies on the order of 1 sec.

 Education: Ph.D. in Computer Science and/or educational concentration in Data Science

 Benefits Compensation 

 CHF 140.000-150.000 + significant stock options

 If you are ready to build the infrastructure that will power the next generation of travel search, we want to hear from you.

title: Agentic Software Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Über YOO Sali. Wir sind YOO, die Basler Digitalagentur. Wir entwickeln digitale Lösungen, die Prozesse vereinfachen und Teams produktiver machen.

 Dafür arbeiten bei uns Menschen aus unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen eng zusammen – strategisch, kreativ und technisch. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und im digitalen Projektalltag etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. Wir suchen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

 Aufgaben Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen für Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen.

 Effektiver Einsatz von Coding Agents, LLMs und AI APIs im Entwicklungsalltag.

 Anforderungen von Kund:innen verstehen und gemeinsam mit UX, Design und Projektmanagement kritisch auf Vollständigkeit, Eindeutigkeit und technische Machbarkeit prüfen.

 Features so spezifizieren, dass sie effizient AI-gestützt umgesetzt werden können.

 Aktive Mitgestaltung unserer AI-gestützten Entwicklungsprozesse (Tooling, Workflows, Guidelines), um Kundenlösungen schneller und besser umzusetzen.

 Qualifikation Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung.

 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Software-Architektur und Software-Design.

 Praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von AI Coding Tools (z. B. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) sowie ein gutes Verständnis der Möglichkeiten und Grenzen von LLMs und agentic Softwareentwicklung.

 Erfahrung mit Git-Workflows, CI/CD und automatisiertem Testing, damit AI-generierter Code in Kundenprojekten zuverlässig abgesichert ist.

 Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Freude an neuen Technologien.

 Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und cloudbasierten Architekturen sowie mit Docker oder Kubernetes ist ein Plus.

 Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) mit.

 Benefits Work-Life Integration mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und Workation.

 Ein sympathisches Team, das sich auf dich freut und dir hilft, schnell Fuss zu fassen sowie aktive Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten und flache Hierarchien.

 Förderung bei Weiterbildungen und Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn.

 Modernes Büro in Gehdistanz zum Bahnhof SBB.

 Unfallzusatzversicherung und attraktiver BVG-Leistungsplan.

 Lebendige Teamkultur mit Spiel, Sport und Spass.

description:

title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization
description:
About the role Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization : how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

 Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

 And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 The Scope Onboarding & offboarding : sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

 Licensing & entitlements : seats, plans, feature access and limits across the Excel add-in and Alwin, for self-serve user

description:

Van feta-ovenpasta tot knapperige aardappelsalade en van chopped sandwich tot de omelet uit The Bear - jij was er allemaal als eerste bij. Je maakt foto’s en short-form video’s waar menig maag van gaat rommelen en je weet deze beelden tot hapklare content te maken.  Je weet welke ingrediënten er nodig zijn om de lekkerste foto’s en video’s te maken en kunt deze beelden zelf bewerken tot smaakmakende content.

title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
AI Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

 Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence. 

 Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses. 

 Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. 

 How we work 

 Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. 

 Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. 

 Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. 

 What will you do? 

 The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. 

 The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. 

 The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. 

 Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. 

 Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. 

 Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description:
About Huzzle Labs Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance.

 About the Role 

 Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance.

 This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.

 Responsibilities Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books.
 Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly.
 Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo.
 Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears.
 Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.”
 Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria.
 Requirements 

 At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations.
 Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.
 Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accrual

title: Engineering Fellowship
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. 

The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.

We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.

We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

title: Senior Software Engineer

As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation.

 Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

 Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben – indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten kannst du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

 Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

 Unsere Technology: 

 Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

 Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

 Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

 Die Rolle 

 Als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Fördermittelmanagement erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Projektförderung und Digitalisierung. Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team bei öffentlich geförderten Forschungsprojekten und arbeitest an Themen wie Reporting, Datenaufbereitung und Prozessoptimierung.

 Bei uns kannst du Finance nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft kennenlernen, sondern auch aktiv mitgestalten: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, entwickeln neue Prozesse und nutzen moderne Technologien wie KI, um unsere Arbeit effizienter zu machen. Wenn du gerne mit Zahlen arbeitest, neugierig auf neue Technologien bist und eigene Ideen einbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf dich!

 Das sollte dich begeistern 

 Einblicke in die Finanzierung öffentlich geförderter Forschungsprojekte und Mitarbeit am Fördermittelreporting

 Analyse und Prüfung von Finanz- und Stundendaten sowie Unterstützung bei finanziellen Nachweisen

title: Research Scientist, Synthetic Organic Chemistry
description:
About us 

 We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

 If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

 We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK.

 The role 

 We're looking for a chemist who combines organic synthesis with strong analytical expertise. You'll synthesise biological molecules — including peptides, nucleic acid derivatives, and modified building blocks — and develop methods to understand how they behave in chemical and biochemical reactions.

 Analytical method development is a central part of the role. You'll use chromatography and mass spectrometry to identify products, quantify reaction progress, and resolve complex mixtures. Working closely with our enzymologists and computational scientists, you'll help decide what to make, how to measure it, and what the results tell us about the underlying chemistry.

 What you'll do 

 Design and execute syntheses of biological molecules and their derivatives, optimising reaction conditions and purification strategies.

 Develop and troubleshoot LC-MS/MS methods, particularly triple-quadrupole methods for targeted quantification of substrates and products.

 Apply Orbitrap-based proteomics workflows to characterise peptides, proteins, and their modifications.

 Establish compound identity and purity using chromatography, NMR, and mass spectrometry.

 Work with experimental and computational colleagues to design assays, test proposed chemistry, and investigate unexpected results.

 Build reproducible synthetic and analytical workflows, with appropriate controls, calibration, and clear documentation.

 Essential experience 

 We're interested in what you've made and measured, and how you approached the chemistry. We care about:

 Practical experience in organic synthesis of biological molecules, particularly peptides and/or nucleic

title: Staff Software Engineer (ML QA)
description:
About the job

Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.

You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack.

You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling.

This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour.

The team and culture

Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability.

You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software.
  • Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments.
  • Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code.
  • The ability to mentor junior engineers and influence engineering practices through constructive feedback.
  • A self-directed approach to solving complex problems, identifying gaps and driving improvements.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

description:

The Internship Programme at Graphcore

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.

Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware.

In AI Compute Libraries & Performance, you’ll contribute to C++ libraries and compute kernels for machine learning workloads. Your work will include:

  • Developing compute kernels: Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations.
  • Understanding and improving performance: Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance.
  • Checking correctness and reliability: Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use.

Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable.

Your team and support

You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.

title: Senior SoC Architect
description:
Shape the high-speed interfaces and silicon sub-systems behind Graphcore’s next AI acceleration platforms.

As a Senior SoC Architect in Bristol, you’ll translate product requirements into specifications for complex, highly integrated, high-performance silicon devices. You’ll own sub-system architecture, modelling, validation and evaluation, connecting early design choices with practical implementation. You’ll help determine how critical components work together, balancing product needs with implementation trade-offs. Those choices will support the specialised compute that lets AI innovators tackle more demanding problems. You’ll assess third-party hard and soft IP, work with vendors and specify how sub-systems integrate across the platform. You’ll also contribute to silicon bring-up, characterisation and evaluation when your expertise is needed.

Your contribution won’t stop at a specification document. You’ll deepen your understanding of AI acceleration by seeing how architectural decisions play out in working silicon.

The team and culture

Reporting to the Director of Silicon Architecture, you will be working with processor, SoC and system architects. Silicon design, verification, hardware and software engineers are partners in evaluating options and checking implementation correctness. You’ll represent the team in cross-functional working groups, making trade-offs clear and speaking up when designs need further scrutiny. You’ll help teams move forward by resolving complex bugs and improving engineering processes. Mentoring engineers will let you share your judgement and help others develop theirs.

What we’re looking for

  • A degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related subject.
  • A solid understanding of computer and SoC architecture.
  • Experience writing clear technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of RTL development and verification processes.
  • The ability to explain design choices clearly and work across engineering teams.
  • Confidence working across programming languages, with the initiative to take ownership of technical problems.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Put your coding skills to work on the infrastructure that helps Graphcore engineers turn code into reliable software releases.

Working closely with teams developing Graphcore’s machine learning software stack, you’ll help automate repetitive tasks and improve the workflows engineers use every day.

It’ll be something you can point to and say, “We built that”, and continue to own, develop, and maintain long-term. title: Head of Product - H/F
description:
Vos missions 
 Vos missions 

 Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. 

 En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale. 

 Principales responsabilités 

 * Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits.
* Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques).
* Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences.
* Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance.
* Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads.
* Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts.
* Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps.
* Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme.
* Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes. 

 Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA.

 Vos compétences 
 Votre profil 

 Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce ou d'ingénieur (Bac+5), vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience en direction produit ou management d'équipes produit dans un environnement B2B / éditeur de logiciels. 

 Orienté(e) business et marché, vous savez transformer les besoins clients et les enjeux commerciaux en stratégie produit. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les équipes commerciales, la gestion d'investissements et les arbitrages à forte valeur ajoutée. 

 Compétences clés 

 * Stratégie et vision produit multi-produits
* Analyse de marché et veille concurrentielle
* Leadership et management d'équipes
* Construction et pilotage budgétaire
* Culture data-driven et indicateurs business
* IA appliquée au produit
* Méthodologies Agile / Scrum

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. About the Team 

 OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

 Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

 Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures

title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
description:
About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team

Strategic Finance is part of Alma's Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma's economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products.

We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma's P&L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached.

About the job

  • Own your piece of the P&L. Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.
  • Run the key finance processes of your scope. Depending on the scope: pricing, merchant performance reviews, cost and margin analysis, country reviews. You are accountable for their quality, and for making them better at every cycle.
  • Be a real partner to the business. Work day to day with the commercial, product and operations teams, step back from the numbers, and bring a clear recommendation whenever a decision is on the table.
  • Rebuild how finance works with AI. Prototype AI-assisted workflows, industrialise the ones that work, and free up the team's time for analysis and influence. Raising the bar on how we work matters as much as what we deliver.

Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen. 

 Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn. 

 Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s.

title: Freelance Back End / Typescript Developer
description:
At Schuberg Philis, we build mission-critical IT solutions that power some of the most essential operations of our clients. Reliability, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. We are looking for a Senior Freelance TypeScript Software Engineer who enjoys designing and building resilient, high-performance systems that have a direct impact on large-scale operational processes.

As part of our team, you will help shape the future of critical digital infrastructures, working on complex challenges where software quality, scalability, and reliability truly matter.

We are looking for a Senior Freelance Software Engineer with an open mind and a genuine passion for software architecture. Together with our customers, we solve a wide range of challenges, from creating more user-friendly online banking platforms and designing business-critical portals and backend systems, to making industrial environments smarter through the combination of cloud technologies and IoT.

For this specific project, you will work closely with developers and architects to design and build software that connects operator- and customer-facing hardware with a large-scale backend platform supporting parcel logistics operations across an international network of hubs. The platform powers critical parcel handling processes throughout Europe and beyond, serving as a key component in the global logistics chain.

The platform enables parcel intake, sorting, routing, and grouping processes across distribution hubs. It actively interacts with parcels in real time, processing events generated by scanners, handheld devices, and automated sorting systems. Every parcel moving through the network is represented and tracked by the platform, making it one of the most visible and operationally critical systems within the organization.

For this assignment, we are specifically looking for freelance professionals. We offer an initial 6-month contract with the possibility of extension, providing the opportunity to contribute to the continued evolution of a mission-critical platform operating at international scale.

Our ideal colleague brings:

  • 5-7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong experience designing and building microservices and event-driven architectures in cloud environments
  • Proven experience developing backend solutions with TypeScript and Node.js

title: Platform Engineer
description:

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers.

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
  • Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

 Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

 Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

 Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

 Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
description:
TL;DR - Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Als Marktführer in der Kieferorthopädie und mit einer großen Finanzierungsrunde im Rücken skalieren wir nun in andere medizinische Fachbereiche - und du bist an vorderster Front dabei. Als Customer Success Manager setzt du neue Standards für moderne Kundenbetreuung und -entwicklung und übernimmst die End-to-End Betreuung unserer Kunden und hilfst dabei, Kunden pro-aktiv zum Erfolg mit unserem Produkt zu führen.

 Wieso praxipal? 

 Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzen wird. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir wachsen in Rekordgeschwindigkeit und haben vor kurzem eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde in Höhe von $6.7 Millionen mit HV Capital abgeschlossen - und wir fangen gerade erst an.

 Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten – aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Der Austausch findet bei uns ganz selbstverständlich über Teamgrenzen hinweg statt – im Alltag wirst du dabei vor allem mit Julius, Lisa und Daniel eng zusammenarbeiten.

 Wonach wir suchen 

 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, inklusive der Verantwortung für den kompletten Customer Lifecycle (Onboarding bis Renewal)

 Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Detailgenauigkeit

 Klare, überzeugende und empathische Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich

 Datengetriebene Denkweise: Über Kennzahlen und Analysen Entscheidungen treffen und Kunden proaktiv steuern

 Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot) sowie Reporting- und Analyse-Tools

 Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau

 Was du tun wirst 

 In einem Satz: du begleitest Praxen bei der Einführung unserer KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Nutzung und treibst den kommerziellen Erfolg voran

 Du führst (Remote-) Onboardings mit Ärzten und Praxisteams durch

 Du schulst Praxen zur effekt

title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description:
Who we are 

 Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

 Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

   What you will do 

 Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

 Your first job is to turn organic reach into a machine: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

   On a typical day, your tasks may include:

 Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

 Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment

 Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

 Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

 New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from new communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

 Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

 Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

 Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

   Who you are 

 We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

 Typically, your profile will look like this:

 Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

 Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer for Data and Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on.  Data collection: keeping our external data integrations reliable as sources and APIs change

 Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

 Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

 Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

 We look for battle-tested data scientists who understand that real impact comes from turning messy, unstructured data into business-critical insights that drive company direction. You don't just build models: you solve business problems and translate statistical findings into actions the team takes.

 Background: a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Math or a related quantitative field

 Experience: 3 or more years of hands-on data science in fast-paced business environ

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
description:
About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

 We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

 The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

 The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

 These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

 They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

 They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

 They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

 They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

 They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

 What you'll do Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

 How we build Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

 Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

 Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

 Wir sind ein Tech-Unternehmen und glauben, dass sich Gesundheitsversorgung deutlich weniger nach Papierkram anfühlen sollte und viel mehr nach Menschen. Deshalb entwickeln wir Technologie, mit der medizinische Praxen einfach, effizient und ohne administratives Chaos arbeiten können.

Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

 As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

 The impact you will have: 

 Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

 Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

 Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

 Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

 What we’re looking for: 

 Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise.

 Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

 Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills.

 Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

 Strong written and verbal communication.

 About the Team: 

 The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors, and the seat is designed to accelerate your development.

 Team Operating Rhythms: 

 Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

 Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near foll

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

 We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

 We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

 In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

 The role You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

 Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

 We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

 Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

 Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows.

 Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

 Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

description:

 The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

 This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

 About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

 building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

 We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

 The role You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

 On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

 Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditions, what came out, and what failed. Failed expressions and poor yields are kept as data, so they get the same care as the successes.

 As protocols settle you will help move them from the bench onto liquid handlers and our automated platform, working with the engineers who build it. This is a hands-on bench role, and in a small team you will also support the work either side of production when it needs doing. Downstream, that means molecular characterisation runs. What You’ll Bring:
