title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis) 
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

 Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)

 About Intero Integrity 

 Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

 The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

 We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

 The opportunity 

 This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

 What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

 Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.

What you will do 

 Hands-on software development 

 • You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

 • You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

 • You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

title: Senior Integrity Engineer

Senior Integrity Engineer 

 Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

 An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

 Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

 About Intero 

 Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.

 Your team

The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

 An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

title: Principal MEMS Development Engineer
description:
About SiTime

SiTime Corporation is the precision timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power and better reliability. With more than 3 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best silicon Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. As a Principal MEMS Development Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to push forward MEMS technology and engineer resonators for SiTime’s next-generation timing products. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects.
  • Advise management of challenges, impact, recommendations.
  • Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products.
  • Design MEMS devices and characterize their electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance on wafer level and/or device level.
  • Work with process team to drive continuous improvement in MEMS yields.
  • Extend and enhance automated infrastructure for MEMS design, measurements, and data analysis.
  • Design and analyze experiments to understand device physics, materials, and fabrication.
  • Interface with local and overseas vendors.
  • Work in cross-functional teams, including circuits, systems, and packaging.
  • Working/supporting other projects as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in ME, EE, Physics, or equivalent
  • At least 3 years of industry experience.
  • Skilled scientist with ability to design, conduct, and analyze experiments.
  • Excellent problem identification and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent knowledge of mechanics, electrodynamics, thermodynamics.
  • Knowledge in fundamentals of MEMS device

title: Teamleider en Senior Adviseur Brandveiligheid
description:
Ben jij een ervaren Adviseur Brandveiligheid die niet alleen excelleert in complexe, grootschalige projecten, maar ook graag het voortouw neemt in het aansturen, coachen en laten groeien van een team? In deze rol combineer je inhoudelijke expertise met leiderschap en speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons team Brandveiligheid. 

 De uitdaging 
 Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Het team bestaat momenteel uit een mix van ervaren experts en talentvolle adviseurs en bevindt zich in een fase van sterke groei. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering.

 Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd.

 Brandveiligheid zit in ieder project. Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex. title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe.  GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

 As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

 You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

 You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

 You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

title: Founding Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

 Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

 Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

 Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

 We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

 We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

 Where we are today:

 Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

 Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

 $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

 The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

 Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description:
Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) (m/f/d) Location: Munich 

 Shape cybersecurity and resilience for generations to come
 As Chief Information Security Officer at Viessmann Generations Group, you will shape our long-term cybersecurity vision and strengthen security leadership across the Group and its portfolio. At the heart of the role is establishing clear governance and ownership, aligning cybersecurity with business priorities, and strengthening long-term resilience.

 This is an opportunity to combine deep cybersecurity expertise with strategic leadership in a purpose-driven, entrepreneurial family enterprise with a long-term perspective.

 Viessmann Generations Group As a globally active, independent family business in its fourth generation, we have been shaping living spaces for generations to come since 1917. Under the leadership of Max Viessmann, we pursue our mission with a long-term perspective and entrepreneurial spirit.

 Today, the Viessmann Generations Group supports over 30 mid-sized companies and family businesses across Europe and the US as well as a broad real assets portfolio – all united by their active contribution to the energy transition. We invest capital, expertise, and passion in three core impact areas:

 Climate : Renewable energy, carbon reduction, and green infrastructure

 Water : Solutions for water scarcity, quality, and efficiency

 Food : Sustainable agriculture, supply chain innovation, and food technology

 Our goal: to create impact – ecological, societal, and entrepreneurial.

 The Viessmann Way supports how we work, lead, and create value together - whether as a team member, entrepreneur or partner in our ecosystem. It is not a rulebook, but a compass: a living set of principles shaped by over a century of entrepreneurship and guided by our long-term purpose.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

 Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems. 

 EggAI Labs We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

 As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

 The problem: EvalOps How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions? 

 We will explore  EvalOps : the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

 These questions will guide the initial work:

 Regression suites : How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

 Coverage estimation : How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

 Live monitoring : Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

 Eval analysis : How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

 Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About us

 EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

 Your role

 You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

 Your responsibilities

   ● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

 ● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

 ● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

 ● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

 ● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers — or get up to speed on them quickly

 ● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

 ● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

 ● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

 What you bring

 Must have

 ● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

 ● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

 ● Very good DATEV skills and

title: Founding Head Of Talent
description:
Look around you. The office building you're sitting in, the hospital down the street, the data centers powering the AI boom. Every one of them was designed by architects and engineers on software from 1997 and mountains of paperwork.

 Because of this, engineers spend 40% of their time not engineering.

 The team you build is the company you build. We believe this is the most important role in our company.

 We're looking for top-tier talent. For the right person, compensation won't be the limiting factor.

 Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit.  Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

 Du verantwortest Programmatic Video, CTV, Online Video und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte, von der Kanalstrategie über das Setup bis zur laufenden Optimierung.

 Qualifikationen 

 Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Media-Management auf Agentur- oder Unternehmensseite mit Schwerpunkt Programmatic Video, CTV oder Online Video.

 Fundierte Hands-on-Erfahrung mit DSPs wie DV360 oder The Trade Desk, mit CM360 und Adservern sowie mit Paid Social Video auf Meta, YouTube und TikTok.

 Tiefes Verständnis von Video-Inventar, Auktionsmechaniken, Deal-Typen und CTV-Besonderheiten wie Frequency Capping und Viewability.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

 We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

 What You'll Do Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

 Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
 Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
 Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
 Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
 Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.
 What You Bring Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
 Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
 Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
 Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
 Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.
 Why Limatica Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
 Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
 Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
 Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning

title: CyberArk Architect
description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building. 

 CyberArk Architect 

 3+ months rolling contract 

 Newbury, UK 

 About the role 

 We are seeking a CyberArk Architect to lead solution design for a large-scale, TSA-regulated Privileged Access Management (PAM) migration and merger consolidation programme. This is a hands-on architecture role spanning vault migration design, identity federation, and application onboarding strategy for an estate spanning thousands of accounts and 250+ dependent applications, delivered against a fixed regulatory deadline. 

 Key responsibilities 

 Migration & vault architecture 

 Design the end-to-end migration architecture from CyberArk v12.2 to v14.2, covering entity extraction (REST API primary, PACLI fallback), transformation, reconciliation, and staged loading into the target vault. 

 Define the staged-ingestion model: disabled import → CPM soft-verification → dual-run mirroring → forced rotation at cutover — ensuring no credential is exposed to a script or human during migration. 

 Own name-collision resolution, platform normalisation, and policy reconciliation rules between source and target environments. 

 Produce migration runbooks, RAID logs, and effort-sizing models across Safes, Accounts, Platforms, and Policies. 

 Application & credential provider (CP/CCP) strategy 

 Lead discovery to segment the 250+ dependent applications by integration pattern (CP agent, CCP centralised, Conjur, direct SSO) — the primary driver of onboarding sequencing and timeline risk. 

 Design the CP/CCP re-onboarding approach, including AppID re-provisioning, certificate/mTLS re-issuance, and phased cutover waves. 

 Define rollback and dual-run strategy per wave, including the read-only fallback window on the source vault. 

 Identity federation & MFA 

 Design PVWA federation to Entra ID via SAML/OIDC, including claims mapping from Entra groups to CyberArk Vault Users and Safe membership. 

 Architect the RSA SecurID → Entr

description:
A World-Changing Company

 The Role 

 We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world’s hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption. 

 You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimized, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date. 

 You will own improvements from design through production, whether that means developing a planning rule, extending a native execution engine, or improving the way large tables are scanned and updated. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build. A change in a shared engine can benefit applications across the platform and the people who rely on them. 

 Join us if you want to advance the capabilities of modern data systems and apply that work to consequential problems. 

 Technologies We Use 

 Java, Scala, Rust, and Python

 Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution

 Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability

 Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage

 Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Cargo, and GitHub.

 Core Responsiblities 

 Designing and implementing query planning and optimization capabilities that turn complex computations into efficient execution plans

 Extending execution engines with new capabilities and improving query operators, parallelism, memory management, and data movement

 Developing Foundry’s Iceberg catalog

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad - UK Government
description:
A World-Changing Company 

 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. 
 The Role 

 Forward Deployed Engineering is a radical commitment to the outcome. This is Palantir’s operating ethos. We pioneered this unique position, embedding engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.

From hospital beds to factory floors, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) embed themselves in the customer’s reality until the problem is theirs. This requires walking many miles in a customer’s shoes, building past the perimeter of what the product currently offers, and deviating from every pre-existing formula to solve the problem. Whether that problem is “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks across a power grid?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global supply chain to deliver critical parts on time?” You’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact. 

 Core Responsibilities 

 To solve mission-critical problems by deploying software and AI into the high stakes operations of the world’s leading institutions. This requires a ruthless commitment to truth-seeking and prioritizing real outcomes. 

The work is difficult. The stakes are real. You will work in small, high-trust teams and own projects end-to-end, from the first conversation with a customer, to shipping the product that changes how they operate. You will embed with the customer, the chaos, and the consequences, and will be entrusted with real ownership to:

 Collaborate with engineers to make architecture and design decisions

 Wrestle with data at a scale that breaks assumptions and demands invention

 Build custom applications, LLM workflows, and production solutions engineered for a specific customer's reality

 Own relationships with stakeholders from the users in the weeds to the executives making the calls

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer

 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

title: Backend Software Engineer - Infrastructure, Foundations
description:
A World-Changing Company 

 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. 
 The Role 

 Backend Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations use data. Our Software Engineers are involved throughout the product lifecycle, from idea generation, design, prototyping, and production delivery. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical teammates to understand our customers' problems and build products that solve them. We encourage movement across teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different technologies and aspects of each product. Engineers work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop, becoming a strong technical contributor and engineering leader. 

 Our Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product. Our infrastructure teams are responsible for the lowest layers of our software stack, often focused on database technologies, distributed systems, large scale data systems, security, and application infrastructure. As a Software Engineer on infrastructure, you'll contribute high-quality code to underpin Palantir Foundry and Gotham with performant, secure, and scalable building blocks, enabling products deployed to the most important institutions in the public and private sector. You'll build the foundational capabilities that power our products used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world. 

 We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them. 
 Core Responsibilities 

 Building a performant search and indexing ecosystem for complex granularly permissioned data

 Contributing to open-source data processing libraries, integrating the latest innovations to achieve performance gains

title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. 

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 

 MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. 

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. 

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. 

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. 

 About MoonPay Enterprise 
 MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

 KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regula

title: Senior Project Manager (EMEA or USA)
description:
Company Overview: 

 At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning , we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career. 

 Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it. 

 Position Summary 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning. 

 As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live. 

 Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart. 

 You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it. 

 You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

 Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release.

 Proven experience in the field and outbound sales , ideally within solution-based, technology, or hospitality environments. 

 Strong understanding of the hospitality industry , including key segments and operational considerations.

title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
description:
Résumé Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

 Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech.

 Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses.

 Notre culture Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience .

 Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

 Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust .

 Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

 Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

 Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

 Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

 Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

 Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

 Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes.

title: DIGITAL & B2B MARKETING MANAGER H/F - CDI
description:
Chez Mistertemp’ Group, nous allions innovation digitale et proximité locale pour révolutionner le monde du recrutement (intérim, CDD, CDI). Présents en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Canada, nous sommes fiers de figurer parmi les 12 startups HR Tech les plus innovantes en France et d’être lauréats des prestigieux French Tech 120 et Next 40. 

 Grâce à notre plateforme technologique de pointe et à notre réseau de 250 agences, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen du recrutement. Pour relever ce défi, nous recherchons des talents créatifs, curieux et passionnés, prêts à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en constante transformation. 

 Si ces valeurs vous inspirent et résonnent avec vos aspirations professionnelles, rejoignez l’aventure ! Nous recherchons un(e) Digital & B2B Marketing Manager (H/F) pour renforcer nos équipes au sein de notre siège basé à Clichy. 

 Vos deux objectifs business Générer davantage de RDV qualifiés pour les équipes Grands Comptes 

 ● Concevoir et opérer des dispositifs d'acquisition et de génération de leads B2B pour alimenter les équipes commerciales Grands Comptes.

 ● Mobiliser les leviers digitaux au service de la prise de RDV : SEO/contenu, campagnes, landing pages, nurturing, social selling…

 ● Piloter la qualification et le suivi des leads jusqu'au RDV, en lien avec les outils CRM (Salesforce).

 ● Suivre la contribution du marketing au nombre et à la qualité des RDV, et optimiser le coût et le taux de conversion.

 ● Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes Sales concernées, de la conception à l’optimisation des actions.

 2. Développer le business des agences du réseau (250 agences)

title: Stage - Data Engineer - ML (H/F)
description:
Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé.

 Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil…
Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain.

 Votre mission 
L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs.
Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de :

 Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents.
 Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non).
 Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes.
 Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés.

 Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale.
Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage.

description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : 

 École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

 Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

 IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

 Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

 Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description:
About this position As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

 Your tasks: 

 Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

 Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

 Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

 Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

 Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

 Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

 Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

 Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

 Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

 Role requirements Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC) .

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the runtime systems of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building low-latency, high-throughput systems that serve search queries in real time. You will work on the critical path of user-facing requests, where performance, predictability, and efficiency directly impact product quality. You will design and operate systems that handle thousands of requests per second under strict latency budgets, optimising every layer from request handling to data access and response assembly.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

 Über uns 
 Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

 Über die Rolle 
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

 Woran du arbeiten wirst 

 Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

 Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

 Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

 Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

 LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimier

 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

title: Strategy Lead - Acquisition

The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

 That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

 We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

 The team The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus:

 Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed.

 Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

 Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

 We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

title: Environmental Compliance Manager (m/w/d) – PFAS & Kreislaufwirtschaft
description:
PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.

 Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert. Als verantwortliche Person nach EfbV leitest und beaufsichtigst Du unsere Entsorgungstätigkeiten, erledigst alle Formalitäten mit Prüfstelle und Behörden und berätst unser Team in allen Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen.

 Aufgaben Zertifizierung als Entsorgungsfachbetrieb verantworten: Umfang festlegen (Tätigkeiten, Standorte, Abfallarten), Prüfstelle auswählen, Überwachungsvertrag abschließen, Erst- und Jahresprüfungen begleiten

 Betriebsorganisation nach EfbV aufbauen und pflegen: Organisationsplan, Arbeitsanweisungen, Betriebstagebuch, Versicherungs-, Zuverlässigkeits- und Fachkundenachweise

 Alle behördlichen Formalitäten erledigen: Anzeigen und Erlaubnisse nach KrWG, Anträge, Fragenkataloge und Fristen

 Geschäftsführung, Operations, Technik und Vertrieb in Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen beraten, von der AVV-Einstufung bis zur Wahl der Entsorgungsroute

 Abfallströme aus unseren mobilen Einsätzen, Labor und Technikum einstufen, Analytik veranlassen und Entsorgungspartner qualifizieren

 Entsorgungsnachweise, Begleitscheine, eANV und Register führen und Kunden belastbare Nachweise über den Verbleib liefern

 Genehmigungsbedarf neuer Geschäftsmodelle bewerten

 Mitarbeitende unterweisen, interne Audits durchführen und Änderungen im Abfall- und PFAS-Recht verfolgen

 Anforderungen Abgeschlossenes Studium, Fachschul- oder Berufsausbildung oder Meister in Chemie, Verfahrens-, Umwelt- oder Entsorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet

 Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Abfallwirtschaft, idealerweise mit gefährlichen oder flüssigen Abfällen

 Fachkunde nach § 9 EfbV mit anerkanntem Fachkundelehrgang

 Zuverlässigkeit im Sinne von § 8 EfbV, nachgewiesen durch Führungszeugnis und Gewerbezentralregisterauszug

 Sichere Kenntnisse in KrWG, EfbV, NachwV und AVV sowie Praxis mit dem eANV

 Erfahrung mit Zertifizierungsaudits und souveräner Umgang mit Behörden und Sachverständigen

 Strukturierte, gründliche Arbeitsweise mit sicherem Gespür für Fristen und Dokumentation

 Deutsch verhandlungssicher, auch im Behördenschr

title: Interesse an admkrs? (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission 
 Kurz vorab: Wir schreiben hier keine Stelle aus. Diese Seite ist für Leute, die admkrs kennen, unsere Arbeit verfolgen und einen konkreten Grund haben, warum sie genau hier hingehören. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft, lies weiter. Wenn du gerade an zwanzig Agenturen dieselbe Bewerbung schickst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Ort.

 Du sagst uns, welche Lücke du bei uns schließt. Nicht wir dir. Wir sind rund 20 Leute in München, arbeiten für Marken wie ESN, arena und asambeauty an Performance-Kampagnen, Creatives, Video und eigener Technologie. Vieles davon ist öffentlich sichtbar: unsere Cases, unsere Creatives, unsere Tools. Schau dir das an und sag uns, wo du andocken würdest und was dadurch bei uns besser wird.

 Dein Profil 

 Du hast dir admkrs angeschaut und kannst in drei Sätzen sagen, warum wir und nicht irgendeine Agentur.

 Du hast ein Fachgebiet, in dem du richtig gut bist: Performance Marketing, Creative und Design, Video und Motion, Strategie oder Entwicklung.

 Du zeigst Arbeit statt Buzzwords. Ein Link zu Projekten, Creatives, Code oder Kampagnen sagt uns mehr als jedes Anschreiben.

 Du lebst in München oder bist gerade dabei, hierher zu ziehen. Wir arbeiten zusammen im Office am Gärtnerplatz, dafür muss dein Lebensmittelpunkt hier sein.

 Warum wir? 

 Kurze Wege: Strategie, Design, Video und Performance sitzen an einem Tisch, Feedback kommt in Minuten statt in Tagen.

 Kreative kennen die Zahlen, Media Buyer die Ideen. Wir entwickeln Arbeit gemeinsam weiter.

 Eigene Technologie: Unser Entwicklerteam baut Tools, KI-Skills und Schnittstellen für den Alltag. Was fehlt, bauen wir selbst.

 Ein Office, in das man gern kommt, mitten in München.

 Darauf schauen wir 
 Wir lesen jede Bewerbung, die hier ankommt, und du bekommst in jedem Fall eine Antwort. Entscheidend sind drei Dinge: ein konkreter Grund für admkrs, sichtbare Arbeit und eine Vorstellung davon, welche Rolle du bei uns ausfüllen willst. Eine allgemeine Bewerbung ohne Bezug zu uns hat hier keine Chance. Das ist nicht unfreundlich gemeint, es spart uns beiden Zeit.

 Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Im Bewerbungsformular fragen wir, warum admkrs und warum du, in welchem Bereich du dich siehst und wo wir deine Arbeit sehen können. Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese Angaben bitte in deine Nachricht oder deinen Lebenslauf.

 Wir nehmen uns Zeit für die Antwort, das kann ein paar Tage dauern.

Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this team:

At Liftoff, the View Master team plays a crucial role in the company's success. Our team builds mobile SDKs (iOS, Android, Windows), and systems that connect Liftoff’s publishers with advertisers, managing applications, campaigns, and creatives that feed into our ad serving pipeline. We create innovative advertisements viewed by millions daily, ensuring a seamless user experience and optimizing ad performance. We're a group of innovative engineers who leverage the latest technology to develop efficient and scalable systems. If you're passionate about building and scaling low-latency, high-throughput systems, we'd be delighted to speak with you!

  • Set and evangelize testing strategy and standards (unit, integration, automated) across the team, not just execute against existing practices
  • Design and drive experimentation and canary-release strategy for ad unit performance, including recommending which approaches to pursue

title: BDR Manager
description:
About Kernel 

 Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

 The Role 

 We have strong product market fit. In 2025 we grew ~5x with world class net dollar retention, mostly from founder-led sales, and now have AEs hitting quota with an emerging playbook.

 We're looking for another BDR Manager to accelerate our outbound engine as we scale in 2026. You'll own a team of ~10 BDRs and be responsible for the pipeline that fuels our growth.

 You will report to Dave Bentham (Head of Sales) and work closely with our AEs, marketing, and leadership team to make sure the top of funnel is consistently feeding high-quality pipeline.

 What You’ll Be Doing 

 Set the strategy 

 Work with Dave and the rest of leadership to define ICP, targeting, and outbound messaging.

 Translate company targets into clear, measurable BDR goals and ensure pipeline expectations are distributed strategically across the team.

 Continuously iterate on outbound plays, channels, and sequences to improve conversion at every stage.

 Develop the BDR team to be a talent pool for the rest of the organisation through a culture of constant learning

 Set your team 

 Manage and develop a team of ~10 BDRs across inbound and outbound.

À propos de Scento Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

 Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. title: Co-founder / Treuhänder/in – let's build the Treuhand of 2030
description:
Build the Treuhand of 2030. Co-founder wanted: certified fiduciary (Treuhänder/in).

 We believe that by 2030 at the latest, AI agents will handle most routine work in a Treuhand. That leaves fiduciaries with the work that needs judgment: reviewing, advising clients and signing off.

 We are founding that Treuhand for Swiss startups and SMEs. AI agents prepare the work, and a qualified fiduciary signs off everything that goes to clients and authorities.

 Underneath runs a finance stack built for agents, with clean data, a full audit trail and connections to the systems clients already use. Long term, we aim to run our clients' whole finance function on this stack, from bookkeeping to reporting, planning and investor/board updates.

 Where we stand The company is not founded yet. We are testing the problem in interviews with founders, CFOs and fiduciaries, three startups are interested in a paid pilot, and we have built a first prototype. You would join from day one and build the company with me. We will add a technical co-founder at a later stage.

 Who you would work with I'm Jonas Baer, two-time entrepreneur and fractional CFO for Swiss startups. As a Venturelab trainer and Innosuisse expert, I work closely with Swiss founders, the clients we want to serve. Before that I was CFO and director at a startup where we grew revenue to almost CHF 10M and the team to over 40. I studied Business Informatics at UZH and bridge finance and IT (linkedin.com/in/jonas-baer).

 What you would do Decide which workflows we automate first, where the AI acts alone and where a fiduciary signs

 Teach the agents Swiss practice (MWST, AHV/BVG/UVG, booking rules) and test them on real documents

 Serve the first pilot clients yourself

 Build and lead the operations team as we scale

 You have the final say on what gets booked, filed and signed.

 What you bring Treuhänder/in mit eidg. Fachausweis or dipl. Treuhandexperte/-in (or comparable)

 4+ years of experience with SMEs and startups

 Hands-on with accounting systems such as Abacus, Bexio or Odoo (migration experience is a plus)

 Daily user of AI tools

 Founder mindset, comfortable deciding with incomplete information

 Fluent in German and English

 Based in or near Zürich

 Your opportunity This is your chance to design how a Treuhand works, with processes and tools you choose yourself. You join as co-founder with equity and start part-time. We agree on the details personally.

title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description:
The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow.

 Tasks 
 Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline 

 Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems.

 Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units.

 Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations.

 Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases.

 Data Infrastructure & Accessibility 

 Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB.

 Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization.

 Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage.

 Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data.

 Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve.

 Data Quality & Analysis Support 

 Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams.

 Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database.

 Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline.

 Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews.

 Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations.

 Support custom querying of processed datasets.

 Requirements 
 Education & Experience 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

 3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database

title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance

Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien.

 Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn.  Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk.

 Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery.

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

 We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

 Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

 Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. 

 Over de functie 

 De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

 Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

 Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. 

 We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer

title: Process Automation Engineer
description:
Functieprofiel 

 Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

 Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

 Bedrijfsomschrijving 

 NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

 Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.

 Wat ga jij doen! 

 In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

 Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

 Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

 Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

 Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

 Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

 Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

 Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

 Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

 Wat wij vragen! 

 Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

 Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

 Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaa
