🚀 Join SE3 Labs as Assembly Technician! Build the future of autonomous systems with us. Help us get our autonomous systems airborne. You will own the mechanical integration of our systems and ground equipment. Early team, deeptech hardware, real-world deployment.

 About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense.

 Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for a hands-on operator who’s ready to bring these machines into the real world.

 About the Role As our Assembly Technician , you’ll be at the heart of building and iterating our autonomous drone systems. Working closely with our diverse engineering team, you’ll own the integration, mechanical build-out, and workshop operations. This is a role for someone who doesn’t just want to follow plans, they want to help shape them.

 Your work will directly impact flight readiness, technical innovation, and the speed at which we bring our vision to reality.

 Your Responsibilities Build & Integrate: Assemble and outfit next-gen UAVs, from avionics to airframe, ensuring systems are flight-ready, reliable, and easily testable.

 Own the Workshop: Organize tools and materials, manage prototyping equipment like 3D printers, and set up jigs and fixtures for integration and calibration.

 Test & Learn: Run and support system qualification tests; document issues and feed insights back into engineering and product design.

 Improve & Optimize: Challenge designs, suggest better tools or processes, and work closely with engineers to iterate faster and smarter.

 Special Projects: Whether it’s testing a new composite bonding method or tuning flight controllers, you’ll jump in where needed and lead where you shine.

 Your Profile Hands-on Pro: You’ve completed technical training or an apprenticeship in aircraft mechanics, mechatronics, or a similar field, and have 3+ years of experience working on mechatronic systems, preferably in prototyping or low-rate production.

 Execution-Obsessed: You take pride in delivering high-quality results, fast. You don’t wait for perfect instructions. You take initiative, fix problems, and figure things out.

title: Head of Governmental Affairs & Communications
description:
Join SE3 Labs as Head of Government Affairs & Communications Shape how Europe's governments, parliaments and armed forces understand autonomy in defence, and build the function that earns SE3 their trust.

 About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

 We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Government Affairs & Communications team , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

 Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

 About the Role As Head of Government Affairs & Communications , you'll own and lead SE3's policy, public affairs and communications function. You'll set the strategy that shapes how governments, parliaments, armed forces and the press across Germany and Europe understand SE3, and build the team and relationships that turn that positioning into institutional trust and political standing. You'll work directly with our founders and act as one of the company's senior voices.

 What You'll Work On Strategy: Own SE3's government affairs and communications strategy, setting priorities across policy, public affairs and press.

 Team Building: Build, lead and develop the government affairs and communications team as the function scales.

title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description:
Your Role As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product.

 What you'll do End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals.

 RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling: Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping.

 Hybrid Service & Sales Design: Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it.

 Complex Offerings, Made Simple: Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. title: Head of Sales - Mobile Performance Advertising
description:
About REPLUG REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

 From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth.

 Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting.

 We’re now looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of our Performance Ads division, working alongside the founder and the performance team

 If you’re looking for a comfortable corporate Head of Sales role with SDRs and a large team already in place, this isn’t it.

title: Head of Sales
description:
Über DRIVAR DRIVAR ist eine der führenden Plattformen für Sport- und Luxuswagenvermietung mit dem Ziel, der weltweit führende Sharing-Marketplace für Sportwagen und Oldtimer zu werden. Vom Hauptsitz in Magdeburg aus gestaltet das Team die Mobilität der Zukunft und bringt Menschen außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse näher.

 Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst die strategische und operative Führung des Vertriebs für unseren globalen Internet-Marktplatz.

 Du entwickelst neue Vertriebsstrategien und treibst das internationale Wachstum der Plattform voran.

 Du baust bestehende Partnerschaften aus und gewinnst neue Partner im Bereich Sport- und Luxuswagen.

 Du analysierst Vertriebskennzahlen und optimierst unsere Sales-Prozesse kontinuierlich.

 Was du mitbringst Nachweisbare Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise in einer Führungsposition im E-Commerce- oder Plattformumfeld.

 Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Marktplatz-Mechaniken und B2B-Prozesse.

 Führungsstärke, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

 Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Fahrzeuge und automotive Erlebnisse.

 Vorteile bei DRIVAR Wir unterstützen deine berufliche Bildung und bieten dir Möglichkeiten zum Mentoring sowie zur Nutzung bezahlter Co-Working-Optionen. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Optionen und der Möglichkeit zum Remote-Arbeiten. Zudem stellen wir dir einen Firmenlaptop und ein Firmenhandy zur Verfügung und übernehmen eine Entschädigung für Reisekosten.

 Freue dich auf Mitarbeiterrabatte, Gutscheine und Ermäßigungen, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks sowie Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Bei uns sind Haustiere erlaubt und es gilt eine lockere Kleiderordnung.

Du analysierst bestehende Sales-Strukturen, setzt neue Impulse für die Skalierung unserer Plattform und treibst die Expansion unseres Partnernetzwerks voran.

title: Senior Manager Product Cost Optimization – Prozesse & Industrialisierung (m/w/d)
description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

Über die Rolle

Werde Teil von GROPYUS und gestalte aktiv die Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer innovativen Gebäudesysteme. An der Schnittstelle von Produktentwicklung, Engineering, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung identifizierst und realisierst du Kostensenkungspotenziale über den gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer Gebäude hinweg.

Als Senior Manager Cost Optimization - Building Systems spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau transparenter Kostenstrukturen, der kritischen Bewertung technischer Lösungen sowie der Umsetzung von Value-Engineering-Initiativen über unser gesamtes Produktportfolio hinweg.

Diese Position richtet sich insbesondere an Kandidat:innen aus der Automobil-, Luftfahrt- oder Schiffbauindustrie, dem industriellen Fertigungsumfeld oder anderen Lean-geprägten Branchen. Du bringst einen nachweislichen Erfolgsausweis in den Bereichen Kostenoptimierung, Value Engineering und Operational Excellence mit und unterstützt die weitere Industrialisierung unserer Gebäudesysteme.

Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst:

  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Kostenoptimierungsstrategie für unsere Gebäudesysteme, um Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit und Wertschöpfung über das gesamte Produktportfolio hinweg sicherzustellen.
  • Anwendung von Design-to-Cost-, Should-Cost-, Value

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Anlagen- & Rohrleitungsbau - Wasseraufbereitung
description:

 Wir sind ein Familienbetrieb in zweiter Generation mit rund 15 Leuten in Raesfeld und bauen seit über 40 Jahren Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen für Schwimmbäder, Thermen, Hotels und Kliniken: Filter, Verrohrung, Dosier-, Mess- und Steuerungstechnik. Unsere Projekte liegen überwiegend in NRW, einzelne bundesweit. Schwimmbad-Fachwissen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Wer Anlagen- oder Rohrleitungsbau kann, lernt Badewassertechnik bei uns.

 Du berichtest Projektstand und Kosten regelmäßig an die Geschäftsführung

 Nicht deine Aufgabe: Vorkalkulation, Angebote und Vertragsabschluss (Geschäftsführung) sowie die tägliche Führung der Montage (Bauleitung).

 Qualifikation Das bringst du mit:

 Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Projektleiter im Anlagenbau, Rohrleitungsbau, in der Wasser- oder Abwassertechnik oder der TGA, mit eigener Verantwortung gegenüber dem Auftraggeber

 Technische Ausbildung als Ingenieur (z. B. Verfahrens-, Versorgungstechnik, Maschinenbau), Techniker oder Meister

 Sicherheit in der VOB/B: Nachträge, Bedenken- und Behinderungsanzeigen, Abnahmen

 Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu Terminen in ganz Deutschland, gelegentlich mit Übernachtung

 Wohnort idealerweise im Münsterland, am Niederrhein oder im Ruhrgebiet

You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.

Put your programming and Linux skills to work on the software that helps Graphcore’s AI systems run reliably.

As a Graduate Software Engineer in System Software Quality Assurance (QA), you’ll help validate low-level firmware, Linux kernel drivers and platform tools. You’ll design and develop tests, investigate issues and give development teams clear feedback on software quality.

You’ll also maintain and improve continuous integration pipelines across different platforms. Working closely with System Software development teams, you’ll help strengthen test-driven development and solve practical engineering problems that matter to customers.

Your team and support

You will be working closely with a team of passionate engineers who will help you each step of the way. Your buddy will be Myles who has recently completed his own graduate program, they can not only help you with becoming an individual contributor but also suggest some fascinating travel destinations for your next holiday.

How you’ll learn and grow

During the two-year programme, you’ll deepen your systems knowledge through hands-on testing across firmware, Linux kernel drivers and platform tools.

Designing tests will help you understand the foundations on which some of the most popular models run, finding and debugging defects will teach you about the low-level software and interactions with the hardware. You will have a chance to work in the lab configuring hardware connections and work on building automation pipelines to seamlessly run tests in loop and process results.
